articles.author: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc.
articles.headline: AIxC Announces Strategic Pivot to Physical AI and Robotic Operations Commercialization; RoboShare Completes First Paid Commercial Order
articles.summary: AIxC announced an intended exit from its digital-asset treasury strategy and a focus on robotics operations, reporting RoboShare's first paid commercial order. The order's August 15 event date is distinct from this August 18 publication.
